children: TOKYO, Oct 30 (Reuters) - Core consumer prices in Tokyo rose 2.6% in October from a year earlier, government data showed on Friday.
The core consumer price index for Japan’s capital, which includes oil products but excludes fresh food prices, compared with economists' median estimate for a 2.6% annual rise.
